blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY, Philippines — An Ilocos Sur regional trial court has acquitted community doctor Ana Marie Rilloraza-Leung and indigenous rights advocate Alpha Sungay of attempted murder in relation to their supposed ties to the communist rebellion, ruling that prosecutors failed to establish their identities and participation in these supposed crimes. Leung and Sungay were among six people who were arrested in a March 11 raid in Tarlac during a police-military joint operation targeting alleged rebel leaders operating in the Cordilleras.
